title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal
body_md:
**TL;DR**

- Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following reports of extramarital affairs and espionage concerns.
- CFO Colette Kress has been appointed as interim CEO to lead the company.
- Rising interest in artificial intelligence continues despite the leadership turmoil at the chip giant.
- Google released its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, focusing on complex query handling.

The AI industry is reeling from the sudden resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, a development that has triggered a surge in discussions regarding CEO resignation and the future of the AI boom. The departure follows mounting scandals involving alleged extramarital affairs and potential espionage, leading to significant market volatility for the chipmaker. CFO Colette Kress has stepped in as interim CEO, tasked with stabilizing the company alongside new chair Harvey Jones.

Despite the leadership crisis at Nvidia, broader interest in artificial intelligence remains high, with artificial intelligence and the AI boom emerging as rising topics. Meanwhile, Google has expanded its AI portfolio with the launch of Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new model designed to improve performance on complex, multi-part queries. Additionally, companies like Baidu and Google DeepMind continue to advance the capabilities of AI agents in software security and enterprise automation.
